note_measure: Household figures are the headline: postcode centroids classified against flood zones, households apportioned from OA census counts. Zone 2 excludes Zone 3 (no double count). landArea percentages are a secondary measure of land, not properties.
note: Flood mapping is devolved. This dataset covers England (Environment Agency) and Wales (Natural Resources Wales) only. Scottish flood maps are published by SEPA and are not included.
